scope: bounded file/URL/note save→find→exact original→reopen, automatic visibility, separate durable diagnostics, explicit setup/launch/verified snapshot

local.limitations: The 180-case local run predates the final private-result validation / launcher / setup sharing / targeted notice corrections. Their affected checks are separately rechecked; native latest snapshot audit identifies final tested bytes.

native.coverage_method: union of initial affected 180-case run, 3 fixed-case rechecks and 1 focused notice regression; not a fabricated single clean full rerun

acceptance_checks.title: Versioned setup/config/one-command launcher
acceptance_checks.check: Owned seven private sibling roots; known existing DB reopen; unavailable dependency/local NTFS/overlap/untrusted path refused; injected crash at root/config/DB creation never resets unknown DB or publishes ready config early. No read-side lazy initialization. Native guarded setup; real adoption separate.

acceptance_checks.title: Supported UTF8 file save→content search
acceptance_checks.check: Ordinary valid .txt/.md auto and explicit utf8_text other suffix; strict chunk-split UTF8/BOM/CRLF exact bytes/hash/original export; invalid UTF8 no sealed acceptance, explicit new binary route; binary unchanged. Size boundary4MiB/4MiB+1 and64MiB+1 produce honest coverage/refusal, never truncation; pinned content query finds unique interior term.

acceptance_checks.title: Frozen v1 compatibility and exact recovery
acceptance_checks.check: Existing v1 SEALED/DRAFT.pending/READY/accepted intent docs/draft/media/producer/IDs/profile stay exact after new defaults and original gone. New profile frozen mode; source change/cancel/crash checkpoints produce correct INCOMPLETE/SEALED/PREPARED; exact retry/replay adds no duplicate; no auto-upgrade.

acceptance_checks.title: Durable separate diagnostic attempt logging
acceptance_checks.check: Known command failures plus private UNKNOWN etc survive DB reopen. Validate private format + optional canonical receipt separately; stable row/blob correlation, immutable append, explicit SQLite connection close, no nested transaction. Simulated log I/O/busy/size failure after accepted commit preserves canonical truth and reports ATTEMPT_NOT_RECORDED. Kill before append never inferred failure.

acceptance_checks.title: Attempt query and original accepted receipt stay distinct
acceptance_checks.check: Private attempt.get and bounded rowid cursor; accepted receipt expected manifest/hash/pins remains authoritative despite later wrong-hash failure. App read-result schema compatibility including old placeholder and known legacy receipt rows; malformed/future rows surfaced, not accepted silently. Scan exhausted gives incomplete_scan/cursor rather than false absence. No DDL/index change.

acceptance_checks.title: Open UI automatically sees external app save
acceptance_checks.check: Actual second process save with open logical UI model/worker; passive compact observer updates first list snapshot after idle, no overlapping worker, context/root generation guarding, newer head notice retains selected pinned revision/tab. Busy save/close/cancel/DBreplacement/sequence decrease and inaccessible/hot journal paths tested; no automatic writer recovery in observer.

acceptance_checks.title: Visible bounded derived index refresh
acceptance_checks.check: Save/external-change/search when cache stale → separate visible coalesced rebuild operation then query; no mutable canonical query or silent background research. Worker/context cancellation safe; stale/notready/unsupported/size_limit coverage remains explicit. Note title/body and filename plus URL locator-only behavior preserved.

acceptance_checks.title: Reopen/failure and minimal safeguard journey
acceptance_checks.check: prepare/publish/save statuses distinguish Bank acceptance. Reopen local intent + actual receipt after output loss/journal damage with exact retry and immutable history; manual SQLite verified backup snapshot/export on owned roots and reopened copy. Copy limitations explicit; no live file copy/automatic cleanup/new restore scheduler.

acceptance_checks.title: Relevant local/native regression and limits
acceptance_checks.check: Run affected authoring/read/command/search/UI/importer meaningful tests, owned headless subprocess/guards, source/accepted baseline checks. Native capability blockers remain named; no claims that portable tests replace Windows checks. Freeze normal/boundary profile evidence; no repetition of full325suite absent relevant source changes/failures.

acceptance_checks.title: Actual first-use acceptance and documentation closure
acceptance_checks.check: After local/native code checks: actual safe config/setup on user PC, user opens app and checks save file/URL/note→find→original→external update→reopen/status; request precise screenshot only if necessary, no automated main desktop GUI. Record completion/issues→resolution/evidence/receipt and one next pointer to remaining R1_OBJECT_AUTHORING. No fullR1/R2/R3/research release acceptance.

preserved_limits: 64MiB/file,256MiB/package; content4MiB; legacy frozen v1; physical schema/1 and canonical contracts unchanged

user_assistance.when: After implementation/local/native headless tests and reviewed config, before claiming actual usable Bank
user_assistance.action: Open the indicated app and check specific visual save/find/original/reopen/status/external-update journey, optional screenshot. Do not request OS privilege changes as routine setup.
user_assistance.blocking: partially blocking: actual GUI/usability/adoption acceptance only
steps: Open launcher and create/save a small UTF8 file, URL and note
Find an interior file term with content and a note term with body; open and export exact original
Close/reopen and verify preserved material and real receipt
Open a second app instance, save another note and verify automatic appearance in the first window and honest status

limitations: Actual user GUI journey remains pending, no usable-real-Bank adoption claim until UA-1
Original four WinError1314 native secure-reader symlink fixtures preserved as capability blockers
